display.purpose: The headline only; trailing full stop set in Leader Red.

lede.purpose: The supporting promise under the headline.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The form's actual commitment action ("Notify me at launch"). UI Red fill, the brand's documented 5.35:1 white-on-UI-Red button combination.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #c23a26; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c23a26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The lower-commitment teaser ("Get notified") that only reveals the form. BRAND.md's "Paper on Ink" default-button pairing: solid Ink fill, Bone text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #141412; color: #fbf9f5; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c23a26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Email field for the signup form, with a persistent mono label above it.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-input">Email address</label><input id="ds-input" class="ds-input" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #6e6a62; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #d3cdc0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #ffffff; color: #141412; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e6a62; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c23a26; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #c23a26; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill showing the page state, such as Coming soon. JetBrains Mono, the brand's small-caps-style UI tag role.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #6e6a62; border: 1px solid #6e6a62; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview: Editrace reverse-engineers short-form video: the mark is a 9:16 frame cut by a single horizontal scan line, a video being read layer by layer. The system carries that idea through every surface: Ink and Bone/Paper hold the page like a light table and film stock, red is the one signal that moves, and JetBrains Mono gives UI chrome a measured, technical register. The voice is precise, calm and engineered. This page ships the brand's light register: Bone background, Ink text.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white and warm near-black, never cool/neutral greys: the palette is ink-and-paper, not slate-and-white.
One moving accent: red, split between Leader Red (graphics/large display only) and UI Red (every small-scale interactive or error signal) per the brand's own AA-contrast split.
Two-font system: Space Grotesk for reading, JetBrains Mono for the system's own labels.
Flat. No shadows, no gradients. Depth from surface value only.

rules.name: The Scan-Line Rule
rules.body: Red is the only accent on this page. It appears exactly four ways: the logo's own scan line, the primary CTA fill, the focus ring, and error state. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Two-Red Rule
rules.body: Leader Red is for graphics and large display text only. UI Red is for every small-scale interactive or error signal. Using Leader Red for small text is an accessibility regression, not a stylistic choice.

rules.name: No Recolouring the Logo Rule
rules.body: The logo and wordmark ship only as the brand's own supplied SVG/PNG files. Never retype "Editrace" in a font, recolour the mark, or rebuild the lockup.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk reads; JetBrains Mono operates. A sentence is never set in mono, and a label, badge, or timecode-style value is never set in Space Grotesk.

rules.name: The Approved Full Stop
rules.body: A hero headline's trailing period may be set in Leader Red. This is the brand's only sanctioned full-word-level colour break, not a general licence to recolour individual characters elsewhere.

dos: Do keep red to exactly four jobs: the logo's scan line, the primary CTA, focus rings, error state.
Do use UI Red (not Leader Red) for any small-scale text or interactive state.
Do use the brand's own logo/wordmark SVG files, never retyped text.
Do keep Space Grotesk for anything a visitor reads, JetBrains Mono for anything the system labels.
Do give every form field a persistent visible mono label; a placeholder is an example value, never the only label.
donts: Don't recolour, rotate, skew, or rebuild the logo lockup.
Don't add a second accent colour outside the approved palette.
Don't use shadows or gradients to create depth.
Don't set UI chrome (labels, badges, timecodes) in Space Grotesk, or body prose in JetBrains Mono.
Don't link a social or external account that doesn't exist yet. Omit the row until it does.
